title: Chapter 259 The City Lord'S Daughter
content:
Chapter 259 The City Lord'S Daughter

“Master,”

Bai Lushuang's lips moved slightly.

And just then, Jordan Yang on the stage suddenly stood up and whispered: "I admit defeat!"

At this moment, the entire square suddenly became silent.

Most of the people looked at the alchemy master Jordanyang with disbelief. It was hard to believe that this sentence was actually spit out of his mouth.

"Master Qiao, did you admit defeat?!"

But the rest of the people who know the knowledge nodded slightly and agreed.

This is the strength of Shi Liantian.

What makes him amazing is that when others see him refining the alchemy, it seems so reasonable to directly admit defeat.

On the stage, after Jordanyang said this, his face did not look ugly, but instead felt an unimaginable relaxation.

There is no need to compete in the next competition.

Xun Heng stood in the middle of the stage, looking at the two pills in his hand, with a dazed look.

I haven't announced the results yet.

Although he didn't know much about elixirs, he also guessed which of the two elixirs is stronger and which is weaker.

Of course, my own people are stronger.

And it was so strong that it directly made the opponent admit defeat.

He turned to look at Shi Liantian on the other side of the stage, and saw that he looked like an old god was there, which was very irrelevant.

After all, for him, winning over Jordan Yang is simply a small thing and is not worth bragging about.

Seeing this, Xun Heng announced the results of the competition loudly with Anfeng nodding in the corner of Taiwan.

"This alchemy competition will be won by the alchemist in the Huangcheng City, Master Shi Liantian Shi!"

Kill the Refining Heaven!

This name was like a magic sound, and the ears of all the alchemists in the audience instantly exploded.

Suddenly, Jordan Yang turned his head and looked at Shi Liantian as if he had seen a ghost.

"You! No, this, this,"

Jordanyang was already stuttering in his speech at this moment.

Who is Shi Liantian?

In his impression, he was already a person from several eras.

And he was the leader of the alchemy at that time.

He is known as a peerless alchemy monster that has been rare in several eras.

A new alchemy system was created. Although the true book has long been lost, until now, many alchemy techniques have traces of the Heavenly Practice Method.

But now, tell me the founder of the Liantian Pill Method, that Shi Liantian is standing in front of you.

And I just had an alchemy competition with myself.

At this moment, Jordanyang was a little dazed.

It seems like I just had a big dream.

"Senior Liantian, is it really you?"

Jordanyang trembled all over and looked at Shi Liantian not far away in front of him and said slowly.

Seeing this scene, everyone around was stunned.

"Huh? What's the situation?"

"Who is this Shi Liantian? Who can you recognize it?"

"I don't know, but looking at Master Qiao's appearance, it seems that he is quite good at coming."

Listen to everyone's words and I'm talking about it.

Some alchemists couldn't help but curse.

"You local bullies, these are the senior Shi Liantian who has made great contributions to the Immortal Realm's alchemy throughout the ages!"

"The immortal elixir you usually eat is improved by his senior."

"Half of the annotations of the alchemy scriptures in the Alchemy Pavilion of Tiandi Academy were from others."

In the crowd, Tan Songci also spoke, his tone full of respect.

Hearing these words, everyone was suddenly filled with storms.

The old man in front of me is so arrogant!

For a moment, everyone restrained the smile on their faces, replaced by a look of respect.

On the stage, looking at Jordanyang in front of him, Shi Liantian chuckled, "So many years have passed, and someone can still recognize me."

As soon as these words were spoken, it also meant that Shi Liantian recognized his identity.

In an instant, the atmosphere in the entire square was ignited again.

The alchemists whistled to the sky and shouted that the alchemy should be prosperous!

And Jordan Yang was so excited that he couldn't speak.

He said that this was the most enjoyable time he had lost in his life.

Just as he was about to ask something, the void suddenly changed and a familiar aura came.

At this moment, all the people present in the Huangcheng City changed their faces, and they were ecstatic.

"It's the city lord, the city lord is back!"

Someone howled, and the whole deserted city suddenly became restless.

I saw a majestic figure slowly stepping down from the void.

It is Lu Daosheng, the lord of the Huangcheng City.

It is still the unique momentum, the great way is alone, and the invincible momentum is beyond words.

But at this moment, Lu Daosheng's face was not that good.

In a corner of the darkness of the square, An Xing also noticed Lu Daosheng's expression at this moment, and his brows were furrowed.

Just now, the subordinates whom he sent out had already learned about the woman in the Tiandi Academy.

When he learned that Lu Xue was openly driven out of that alchemy meeting, An Xing couldn't help but feel furious.

What a courage.

They were careful in the deserted city, for fear of causing Miss Lu Xue to be displeased.

It's great to have arrived at your place, but I was even driven out.

In his understanding, it is already a great honor for Miss Lu Xue to be able to enter the academy to study.

But obviously, the academy doesn't think so.

As for the right or wrong of this matter, An Xing ignored it at all.

Is it important to be right or wrong?

This world has always been the prey of the weak, and only strength is the hard truth.

If the city lord was bloodthirsty and violent, I am afraid that the Tiandi Academy would have been stepped on to the ground by the city lord.

But with the city lord's temperament, I don't think he would be skeptical of such a trivial woman.

Thinking of this, An Xing sneered.

The city lord didn't care, but he was different.

As a person who lives in the dark all year round, An Xingke has never claimed to be a gentleman.

He is a villain who has not achieved his goal and uses any means.

Otherwise, the city lord would not have let him sit in this seat.

At the same time, Lu Daosheng has also arrived at the alchemy competition platform in the square.

"Welcome to the city lord back!"

Xun Heng was the first to shout respectfully.

Suddenly, the rest of the deserted city responded one after another.

"We wait, welcome the city lord back!"

In the small space in the air, Lu Xue and everyone also stepped out of the small space slowly.

"father!"

Lu Xue was the first to step forward, and the rest of the people followed him.

Seeing Lu Xue, Lu Daosheng finally showed his first smile after returning.

"Xiaoxue."

Around the square, the onlookers were shocked.

This is the first time they have watched the lord of the deserted city so close. It is really powerful.

"That's the daughter of the Lord of the Huangcheng City. She is so beautiful that the whole country is so beautiful. The future is unlimited."

Some people watched Lu Xue's eyes glow.

What's more, some people have the idea of making a soft meal.

"Although I'm a little weak, it shouldn't be too much for me to have a soft meal in my appearance."

"The brother who just spoke, please tell me again. I didn't hear clearly my eighty-meter sword."

"I'm a little tempted to vomit."
